title.narrative: Promoting and Protecting Freedom of Religion and Belief in Nigeria (PP-FoRB)

description.narrative: Search is implementing a 36 months project titled: Promoting and Protecting Freedom of Religion and Belief (PP-FoRB) in Nigeria. Funded by the Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, the project seeks to address potential conflict issues in relation to religious tolerance and tensions in Nigeria, in response to incidents of religious intolerance and religious extremism reported across Nigeria. The activities are designed to strengthen the capacity of relevant actors to collaboratively work against any form of abuses in relation to FoRB across 6 geopolitical zones in Nigeria. Hence, the project’s Theory of Change (ToC) states IF Religious Leaders, Security Agencies, civil society actors and other key stakeholders leverage new and existing platforms to anticipate, prevent, respond to, and address religious-based conflicts and their root drivers AND IF citizens have access to effective and trustworthy FoRB support mechanisms, AND IF capable and conflict-sensitive media practitioners enhance public understanding of FoRB THEN there will be a decrease in religious-based divisions, tensions, and violence BECAUSE citizens will be equipped to implement a holistic series of prevention, response, and support mechanisms, addressing every aspect of the ‘violence cycle’, including both long- and short-term drivers of religiously-motivated violence. The overall goal of the project is to empower actors to prevent and address conflicts along religious lines and advance FoRB in Nigeria. The goal is supported by three specific objectives: Objective 1: To establish effective Early Warning/Early Response (EWER) and referral mechanisms for addressing FoRB violations and violence along religious lines in Nigeria. Objective 2: To strengthen support mechanisms for individuals at risk of FoRB violations. Objective 3: To enhance public understanding of interfaith conflict and the importance of FoRB.

title.narrative: Promoting and Protecting Freedom of Religion and Belief

description.narrative: * Search successfully obtained the commitments from mapped stakeholders to report and respond to Freedom of Religion and Belief violations in their different locations. These stakeholders supported project activities throughout the reporting period. * A situation room has been established to track, collate, analyze, and disseminate early warning signs of FoRB violations for immediate responses. * With the skills acquired from training organized by Search, members of the EWER platform have responded to issues of FoRB violations in Northcentral and Northwest, Nigeria. * Legal practitioners have improved understanding of human rights laws, especially laws protecting FoRB, which has been used to champion cases of FoRB in target states. * The project has provided relevant support to victims of FoRB violations in Northwest Nigeria. *Media professionals (both conventional and social media influencers) have improved capacity to develop conflict sensitive reports on issues related to FoRB.
Annual Report of activities capturing outputs and outcomes.
